claims.quote: we are with you for as long as it takes
claims.statement: The UK is with Ukraine for as long as it takes, and will go further and faster in its support.

claims.quote: Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK
claims.statement: UK support for Ukraine is vital for keeping the UK safe.

claims.quote: Russia’s aggression cannot be allowed to succeed on our continent.
claims.statement: Russia's aggression cannot be allowed to succeed in Europe.

claims.quote: I urge partners to back the ban on Russian LNG, like we have done in the UK
claims.statement: International partners should back a ban on Russian LNG as the UK has done.

claims.quote: the Chancellor will argue that this must be met by European resolve and unity
claims.statement: Russia's bombardment must be met by European resolve and unity.

claims.quote: The drones are faster and can fly far higher than propeller-driven Shaheds, making them harder to detect and destroy before they hit targets.
claims.statement: Jet-powered drones are faster and fly higher than propeller-driven Shaheds, making them harder to detect and destroy.

claims.quote: The UK will accelerate deliveries of British Lightweight Multirole Missiles (LMMs)
claims.statement: The UK will accelerate deliveries of LMMs to Ukraine.

facts.quote: The UK has already committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years
facts.statement: The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years.

facts.quote: the Foreign Secretary did the same with partners at the Warsaw Security Forum yesterday [TUE]
facts.statement: The Foreign Secretary urged partners to fully implement a ban on Russian LNG at the Warsaw Security Forum.

facts.quote: The Prime Minister has also asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid, and fiscal packages to provide urgent support in the coming weeks.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages.

facts.statement: The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.

facts.quote: As Russia continues its bombardment of Ukraine’s capital Kyiv and energy infrastructure
facts.statement: Russia is continuing its bombardment of Kyiv and Ukraine's energy infrastructure.
